text:
incident-bot: Pager alert — billing-metering: token-agg vs ledger divergence detected in eu-west-1. 120 overage flags firing; runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/metering-drift :rotating_light:

mira: ACK, oncall. Jumping in. Any customer-facing impact yet?

jonathan: seeing delayed emits from consumer group `meter-processor-3` (lag 18-45m for some partitions). Overages mostly for low-volume customers but ~12 got email triggers. Investigating dedupe stage.

tara: confirm queue spike on shadow-agg topic, consumers in eu-west-1 have ~400k backlog. Monitoring dashboards: shadow-agg lag trending up since 13:55 UTC.

mira: setting incident priority P1. @jonathan @tara coordinate live mitigation. @support_lead hold outbound customer notices until we have reconciliation.

luis: quick read of ingest logs shows intermittent 503s from embed service under burst traffic — producer retries piling up. Looks like backpressure upstream causing duplicate-ish replays into the aggregation window. Suggest: 1) pause the shadow consumer group, 2) mute overage-alerting webhook (avoid more emails), 3) run a dedupe re-run with tightened window.

jonathan: agreed. Proposed steps (will run):
```
# pause consumer
kafka-consumer-cli pause --group meter-processor-3 --topic shadow-agg
# mute alerts
/alerts mute billing.overage-webhook --duration 60m --reason "inflight metering reconciliation"
# submit dedupe job (idempotent)
jobs submit dedupe-reconcile --window 30m --target=shadow-agg
```

support_lead: noted — support on hold. If customers ping, we present as "we detected transient billing telemetry issue; we're reconciling and will remediate any erroneous flags."

tara: pausing consumer now — command sent. Starting a scaled replayer with rate limit 50 msgs/s after we confirm dedupe job queued.

incident-bot: On-call handover: mira accepted (active).

(30m later)
jonathan: dedupe run completed, initial reconciliation shows ~4 customers received spurious overage flags. Root cause dedup logic edge-case when producer retries included original event with new attempt_id. We flagged and queued refunds for 4 accounts.

tara: backlog drained, consumer lag at ~0, shadow-agg queue stable. No further inflight replays observed.

luis: pushed a patch to the producer to include stable event_id (prevents future duplicate detection misses). Hotfix deployed to eu-west-1 (canary 10% -> 100%). Monitoring look OK.

support_lead: created support ticket batch and refund notes, sent to billing ops to run refunds and remove overage emails from those 4 customers.

mira: re-enabling alerts in 10m to ensure no more noisy windows. Postmortem scheduled for tomorrow 11:00 PT.

jonathan: post-incident checklist: add a stricter dedupe integration test and an alert that ties overage rate to ledger-confirmed counts before emailing customers.

mira: closing incident thread — low customer impact after reconciliation (4 customers, refunds queued). Will escalate to follow-up action items in postmortem. Thanks all :thumbsup:
